result.description: All-in-one SEO platform (rank tracking, keyword research, backlinks, site audits, AI search visibility) with Data, Project, Local Marketing and SE Visible APIs.
result.auth_detail: Single API key from account dashboard, sent as 'Authorization: Token KEY' header (or apikey query param); one key covers Data and Project API. Hosted MCP additionally supports OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration, or X-Api-Key header.
result.access_detail: Key is self-serve generated in the dashboard, but needs a subscription: every paid plan includes monthly Data API credits, Project API included in plans, or standalone/credit-pack purchase (from $50 for 250k credits). No documented free API trial; MCP page mentions 100K free credits start, terms unclear.
result.api_notes: Data API: Backlinks, Domain Analysis, Keyword Research, AI Search, Website Audit, Account. Project API: project mgmt, keyword/URL groups, competitors, analytics traffic, marketing plan, audit, backlink checker, AI results tracker. Plus Local Marketing API and SE Visible API (beta). Base https://api.seranking.com. Credits billed only on 2xx.
result.blocker: API needs a paid subscription or purchased credits; no free self-serve API tier. Official MCP already exists.

evidence.quote: Include an `Authorization` header in your request, with the value `Token YOUR_API_KEY`.
A single API key authenticates every endpoint across the Data API and the Project API.
every current subscription plan includes a monthly credit allowance.
Credit packs that never expire. From $50 for 250,000 credits, with no limit on how many you buy.
Only successful HTTP 2xx responses consume credits.
This transport uses OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration for authentication
API access lives with the master account, not with sub-accounts.
